source_scope.unpinned_degree3: Positive linear exact-3 NAE with <=3 occurrences is in P (Filho; DDD)
source_scope.mixed_degree3: Positive linear NAE-(2,3)-SAT-E3 is NP-complete, including exactly one 2-clause per variable (DDD Theorem 4.3)
source_scope.correction: unpinned decision P does not imply pinned/precoloring escape-selector P

derived_corollary.statement: 2-precoloring extension is NP-complete on linear 3-uniform hypergraphs of maximum degree 3
derived_corollary.stronger_promise: underlying unprecolored construction is guaranteed bicolorable

ceiling: does not yet prove single-pivot escape-selector hardness

active_gate.question: Can a single forced flip plus protected variables activate/distribute the pin-induced parity interface under linear 3-uniform max-degree-3 constraints?
